description.en: Computed the residual-to-total ratio directly without subtracting it from 1.
description.et: Arvutas jääk-kogusuhte otse, ilma seda 1-st lahutamata.

description.en: Divided total sum of squares by residual sum of squares instead of the other way round.
description.et: Jagas kogu ruutude summa jääkruutude summaga, selle asemel et teha vastupidi.

description.en: Used the residual sum of squares alone as if it were already R-squared.
description.et: Kasutas jääkruutude summat üksi, nagu see oleks juba R-ruut.
